detail.title: Dahua 320CH 36-bay 4U Embedded Video Storage
detail.overview: Compare Favourite EVS5136S Dahua 320CH 36-bay 4U Embedded Video Storage Key Points • Max. 320-ch IP Camera Inputs • Max. 800 Mbps Incoming/Recording/Forwarding Bandwidth • 36 Bays, SATA, Hot-Swap • RAID 0/1/5/6/10/50/60, Hot Spare, N+M Cluster • Video Stream/Picture Direct Storage Mode and IPSAN Storage Mode • Modular and Drawer-like Design • 1+1 Redundant 80PLUS Platinum Power Supply Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.AI by Camera: Face detection, face recognition, IVS (abandoned object, missing object, loitering, crowd gathering, parking, fence-crossing, fast moving, tripwire and intrusion), video metadata (human, vehicle, non-motor vehicle), vehicle recognition, people counting (fisheye or people counting camera required),face & body detection, crowd distribution, smart thermal (call detection, visible channel- smoking detection, thermal channel-smoking detection)
General.Thermal: Works with camera for fire alarm, temperature alarm, temperature difference alarm, hot spot, cold spot, smoking and calling
General.People Counting: Works with camera for tripwire people counting, regional people counting and queue people counting
General.Bullet-PTZ Smart Track: Works with camera for manual tracking, auto tracking, click positioning and select positioning
General.Third-party Camera Access: Onvif, Onvifs, RTSP, Sony, Panasonic, Axis, Arecont, Pelco, Canon, Samsung, Hikvision
General.Video Compression: Smart H.265+; H.265; Smart H.264+; H.264; MJPEG
General.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; RTSP; UDP; SMTP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; P2P
General.Browser: Chrome; PCAPP; IE9 or higher; Firefox
General.Network Mode: NIC binding mode such as multiple-address mode, load balance, fault-tolerance, link aggregation, etc
General.Record Mode: Auto record; manual record; search video detection; IO alarm; thermal imaging; intelligent event; all record file
General.Playback Function: 1. Play, pause, stop, fast forward, fast backward, reverse play, frame by frame 2. Full-screen, backup (clip; file), snapshot, digital zoom, audio on; off
General.Video Direct Storage (Private Protocol): Incoming: 320-channel (bandwidth: 800 Mbps) Recording: 320-channel (bandwidth: 800 Mbps) Outgoing: 320-channel (bandwidth: 800 Mbps) Playback: 32-channel (bandwidth: 64 Mbps)
General.Video Direct Storage (Onvif): Incoming: 320-channel (bandwidth: 800 Mbps) Recording: 320-channel (bandwidth: 800 Mbps) Outgoing: 320-channel (bandwidth: 800 Mbps) Playback: 32-channel (bandwidth: 64 Mbps)
General.Video Direct Storage (Auto Register): Incoming: 320-channel (bandwidth: 800 Mbps) Recording: 320-channel (bandwidth: 800 Mbps) Outgoing: 320-channel (bandwidth: 800 Mbps) Playback: 32-channel (bandwidth: 64 Mbps)
General.Video Direct Storage (International Prot: Incoming: 320-channel (bandwidth: 800 Mbps) Recording: 320-channel (bandwidth: 800 Mbps) Outgoing: 320-channel (bandwidth: 800 Mbps) Playback: 32-channel (bandwidth: 64 Mbps)
General.Picture Direct Storage: Incoming: 120-channel (550 KB/picture) Recording: 120-channel (550 KB/picture) Outgoing: 120-channel (550 KB/picture) Playback: 32-channel (550 KB/picture)
General.Record Management: Supports record control (continuous, event-based, scheduled, scheduled & event-based).
General.IPSAN Performance: 280-channel × 2 Mbps video stream writing and 24-channel × 2 Mbps video playback ( I/O size of VMS is 64 KB) 400-channel × 2 Mbps video stream writing and 24-channel × 2 Mbps video playback (I/O size of VMS is 512 KB)
General.General Alarm: Motion detect; tampering; IPC external alarm
General.Anomaly Alarm: IPC offline alarm; storage error; HDD full; video frame loss; SSD exception; IP conflict; MAC conflict; login lock; fan malfunction; no HDD; network security exception; power exception; disk health exception; RAID exception; storage pool exception; temperature alarm; share service
General.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot (full image); alarm uploading; remote device alarm output; camera audio; buzzer; log; preset; email, smart tracking and warning light. Disarming alarm linkage action by period or one-click sync disarm config with channels
General.HDD Interface: 36 slots, SATA, Max.20 T/HDD hot swapping CMR support enterprise-grade HDD
General.RS-232: 1 port, for debug or COM data transmission
General.USB: 4 ports. 2 USB2.0 ports at the front panel and 2 USB3.0 ports at the rear panel
General.Network Port: 4 RJ-45 10/100/1000 Mbps self-adaptive Ethernet ports. (gigabit electrica port) 1 RJ-45 10/100 Mbps self-adaptive Ethernet ports. (100 Mbps electrical port)
General.Power Consumption: <100 W (without HDD, idling) <400 W (all HDDs connected)
General.Certifications: CE: CE-LVD: EN 60950-1/IEC 60950-1 CE-EMC: EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, EN 55032, EN 50130, EN 55024 FCC: Part 15 Subpart B
